source: Massive REST /v2/aggs/ticker/{T}/range/1/day/2025-01-01/2026-11-20 (adjusted=true, sort=asc) via Massive MCP
columns: date (UTC date of bar start), open, high, low, close, volume (rounded to integer shares)
verification: Row count, min(low), max(high), sum(volume) and sums of open/high/low/close in each CSV equal the same aggregates computed by Massive's query engine on the fetched table (exact match).
caveats: Prices are split/dividend adjusted as served by Massive; they differ from as-traded prices.
The 2026-11-20 bar volume was fractional in the source (e.g. NVDA 633418432.84), which suggests a consolidated or still-updating figure; treat that day's volume as provisional.
CRWV and SNDK history starts at listing/spin-off, so 'lowest low' means lowest since first bar, not since 2025-01-01 for those names.
Append-only intent: new bars should be appended; re-fetches that revise history must be recorded as a new revision, not overwritten silently.
